reference.motionSummary: No video, no keyframes, no motion library; movement is CSS micro-interaction — hover wipe-in underlines (8x after:transition-transform, 5x hover:after:scale-x-100), media scale inside cards (2x group-hover:scale-50), opacity/colour transitions and one clip-path+translate, plus a JS-driven fixed ticker and header over a compact ~1397px single page.
